- At game start, let the player choose an allied figure.

- Use a start-of-game figure selection screen.
- Keep the existing chess rules, autonomous opponent, and tactical view.

- (none)

4. Test initial selection, gameplay, reset, undo, and responsive layout in the browser.

- `game.js`: Game state, selection, camera, move lifecycle, and needed dialogue behavior.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person chess game where the player chooses an allied figure, appears as that figure on the board, and sees chat bubbles for figures.
- Add a main menu whose Start button opens a mode-selection screen.

## Requirements
- Preserve chess moves, the autonomous opponent, and tactical view.
- Main menu modes: solo, multiplayer, training, tutorial, classic 2D, and vs Omni Rook.

## Decisions
- Use a start-of-game figure-selection screen.
- Keep existing chess rules, autonomous opponent, and tactical view.
- Modes not implemented yet are marked “Coming soon”; solo is playable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added figure selection, first-person camera tracking, tactical view, chat bubbles, and game-start gating.
- Added a main menu, mode picker, and a route from solo mode to figure selection.
- Updated reset/restart to clear chat bubbles and return to figure selection.
- Corrected player-piece square tracking and recalculated it after undo.
- `node --check game.js` and `npm run build` passed before the latest menu changes.

### Active
- Wire menu and mode-selection controls in `game.js`; current markup has buttons but no event handlers yet.
- Ensure startup opens the main menu rather than directly displaying the figure-selection page.
- Rebuild and validate menu navigation, solo gameplay, reset, undo, bubbles, and responsive layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add menu navigation and mode-button behavior in `game.js`; allow only solo to continue and show feedback for unavailable modes.
2. Initialize the start modal on the main-menu page; connect Field Manual and back/continue buttons.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and `npm run build`, then validate in a browser if available.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, menu/figure flow, camera, chat bubbles, reset, and controls.
- `index.html`: Main menu, mode-selection options, figure selection, and game UI.
- `style.css`: Menu, mode-selection, figure-selection, and responsive styles.
- `package.json`: Build and start scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- New menu markup is present in `index.html` and styling in `style.css`; menu controls are not yet wired.
- `resetGame()` currently calls `openStartScreen()`, which opens the modal but does not navigate to the new menu page.
